subject: general
question: Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary reopened for the 2025–26 tourist season in which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary**, a premier destination for wildlife enthusiasts, officially reopened for the **2025–26** tourist season (following the usual schedule starting in **October/November**) in the state of **Assam**.
 
• It is located in the **Morigaon district** of **Assam** and is situated on the southern bank of the **Brahmaputra River**.
 
• The sanctuary is world-renowned for having the **highest density** of the **Greater One-horned Rhinoceros** (Rhinoceros unicornis). Although **Kaziranga National Park** has a larger total population, **Pobitora** holds more rhinos per square kilometer.
 
• Due to its similar landscape of grasslands and wetlands and its significant rhino population, it is popularly known as **'Mini Kaziranga'**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Assam.***
 
• The reopening ceremony is a significant annual event for **Assam Tourism**, involving local forest officials, traditional **Assamese** rituals, and the commencement of **Jeep** and **Elephant safaris** for visitors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Geography and Habitat**:
 
 
• The sanctuary covers an area of approximately **38.81 square kilometers**, out of which the core rhino habitat is only about **16 square kilometers**.
 
• The terrain consists of **alluvial grasslands** and **swamps**, which are ideal for the survival and breeding of the Indian rhinoceros.
 
 
 
• **Biodiversity**:
 
 
• Apart from rhinos, it provides shelter to other mammals such as the **Wild water buffalo**, **Leopard**, **Golden Jackal**, and **Wild boar**.
 
• It is also an **Important Bird Area (IBA)**, hosting over **2000** migratory birds and various resident species like the **Greater Adjutant Stork**, **Whistling Teal**, and **Grey-panting Lapwing**.
 
 
 
• **Conservation History**:
 
 
• It was first declared a **Reserved Forest** in **1971** and later upgraded to a **Wildlife Sanctuary** in **1987** to protect the burgeoning rhino population.
 
• The sanctuary serves as a critical "backup" habitat; during heavy monsoons when **Kaziranga** floods, animals often find refuge in the highland areas of **Pobitora**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Tourism and Accessibility**:
 
 
• **Pobitora** is highly accessible, located only about **45 to 50 kilometers** from **Guwahati**, the gateway to Northeast India.
 
• The **tourist season** typically runs from **November to April**, coinciding with the dry winter months when visibility in the grasslands is highest.
 
 
 
• **Other Major Parks in Assam**:
 
 
• **Kaziranga National Park**: A **UNESCO World Heritage Site** famous for rhinos and tigers.
 
• **Manas National Park**: Known for its **Project Tiger** reserve and the **Pygy Hog**.
 
• **Orang National Park**: Another rhino habitat located on the northern bank of the **Brahmaputra**.
 
• **Raimona and Dehing Patkai**: The newest additions to **Assam's** list of National Parks, established in **2021**.
